emily: Quick copy check 11 for the rate-limit banner that appears after too many requests. Current text: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." feels vague. jacob: Agreed. Users want to know when they can retry. We have a Retry-After header so we can show a countdown. anika: Two UX options: show absolute time (e.g., "Try again at 14:32 UTC") or relative ("Try again in 32s"). Relative is easier to scan. phil: Also think about action affordances: primary = "Retry now" (if we can attempt immediately), secondary = "Dismiss". But if server requires waiting, "Retry now" should be disabled until countdown ends. Need clear disabled state microcopy. emily: Draft variants for banner text: 1) "Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 32s." 2) "Rate limit reached. Next attempt in 32s." 3) "Too many requests. Retry allowed at 14:32 UTC." anika: For accessibility, include aria-live polite region so screen readers announce countdown updates. Also ensure the disabled retry button has aria-disabled and an aria-label like "Retry (available in 32 seconds)". jacob: I prefer #1 for friendly tone. Short and actionable. For tiny screens maybe shorten to "Retry in 32s" and keep the full sentence on desktop. phil: Proposed final banner structure: [icon] "Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 32s." [Retry now button - disabled] [Dismiss] Subtext (small): "Requests will be accepted after the timer. Contact support if this persists." emily: Implementation snippet for the copy area we can include in the design spec:
Rate limit exceeded. Try again in 32s.
anika: design-bot quick rule? design-bot: Recommendation: use relative time for immediacy, expose updates via aria-live polite, and provide explicit button labels. Use phrasing "Try again in 32s" for mobile and "Try again in 32s" or full sentence on desktop. Avoid vague "Try again later". jacob: Action items: emily -> update banner copy in DS with relative text and disabled button state; phil -> implement aria-live and aria-label on retry button; anika -> add responsive copy variants. I'll review the PR. emily: Will post updated screenshots and copy in this thread. :+1:
